choices.label: Poem 01's sodium Orange Haze rises bottom-to-top off bay, stalling at chest
Quay dissolves into wall-less Black stage; Poet stands luminous
All 9 props (window, tambourine, heart, star, coin, daisy, bike, temple, hourglass) flash
Poet and his Double join hands and orbit in a joyous 360-deg spin
Freestanding vintage door opens onto Poem 01's warm party (window now shut)
Poet crosses the door jamb into the party; door clicks shut; Poet bows at lectern

I2_threshold.rule: All 9 prior poem motifs fire in torrent and door closes onto P01 party (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Uses identical orange_haze_claim() shader as Poem 01; all 9 prior motif sprites appear in torrent.
